controls.description: Post-write material identity and exact seven-file delta were revalidated before the result-only handoff.
All canonical families are rederived and all inherited/new escape dimensions are explicitly saturated.
Controls use exact material bytes, focused execution or exact-diff non-impact evidence rather than generic green status.
When a user owns multiple role-specific commercial states, professional self-use selects the professional subscription while ordinary individual use remains individual.
Distinct plan, product and version identifiers survive billing-to-ledger propagation without semantic relabeling.
Sponsored patient status resolves the professional subscription from sponsorUserId, not beneficiary userId.
